subject: an owl with broad looping brows
art_direction: 两道宽松眉弧与身体轮廓自然相接，米金眼周只保留一点形状。
visible_description: 两道宽松眉弧与身体轮廓自然相接，米金眼周只保留一点形状。
composition: Square 1024x1024 avatar. The distinct subject, face, object or abstract form occupies about 65–80% of the canvas, and remains readable at small size. Important features sit safely near the center with room for a circular crop, but DO NOT draw a circular frame, badge, disc backdrop or circular mask. Render a complete square background. Vary silhouette, expression, angle, asymmetry, and density as the individual direction requests. Appealing eyes and a purposeful expression matter when a face is present; never force a face onto a faceless concept.
creative_direction: Create an owl from a few connected slate lines, using two broad loops to define brows above small steady eyes. Let the outer contour close into a compact body, with one wing suggested by an inward curve. A muted gold eye-plane supplies a restrained accent. Tip the head downward with thoughtful amusement against open warm-white paper. Square 1024x1024, centered with a distinct silhouette and generous circular-crop clearance, without a circular frame. Original peaceful design, no text, branding, or watermark.
